title: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice Soup
directions: Sauté base — butter + oil + onion 3–4 min.
Add garlic 30–45 sec.
Add chicken + seasonings 3–4 min.
Add rice, coat; add stock; deglaze.
Pressure cook 8 min; natural release 5 min, quick release.
Stir in cream + parmesan + lemon. Add spinach 2–3 min. Adjust.

title: Scottish Lentil Soup with Ham Hough

ingredients.item: Thyme or a few sprigs fresh

directions: Set Instant Pot to Sauté (optional). Soften onion, leek, carrot, and celery in butter/oil for 4–5 minutes.
Add rinsed lentils, parsnip (optional), pepper, thyme, bay leaf, and ham hough.
Pour in 2 L water/stock, ensuring hough is just covered (do not exceed max line).
Lock lid and cook on High Pressure for 45 minutes. Allow natural release for 15–20 minutes.
Remove hough, cool slightly, pull meat from bone, discard fat/skin, and shred.
Stir soup (lentils mostly broken down). Mash or blend briefly if smoother texture desired.
Return shredded ham, adjust salt/pepper. Add splash of malt vinegar or pinch of sugar if needed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread or oatcakes.
Slow cook alternative: Combine all ingredients (except parsley/salt). Cook 8–9 hours on Low or 5–6 on High. Shred hough, season, and finish as above.
notes: Traditional Scottish red lentil soup with a smoked ham hough. Dual-mode recipe.

title: No-Knead Overnight Focaccia
directions: Day 1 (Evening) — Mix: In a large bowl, stir water + yeast to dissolve. Add flour, salt, and 40 ml olive oil. Mix until no dry flour remains (do not knead). Cover tightly.
Overnight ferment (Room temp 18–21 °C): Leave 12–16 hours until dough is doubled/tripled, bubbly on top, and jiggly when you shake the bowl. (If not ready, leave longer.)
Day 2 — Tray: Generously oil a metal tray (approx. 23×33 cm). Pour dough in gently (do not punch down). With oiled fingers, coax toward corners. If it resists, rest 10 minutes and continue.
Final proof: Cover loosely and rest 45–90 minutes until puffy and airy.
Oven: Preheat to 220 °C conventional (200 °C fan).
Dimple + top: Oil your fingers and press deep dimples all over down to the tray. Drizzle olive oil so it pools in dimples. Add flaky salt and rosemary (optional).
Bake: Bake 22–28 minutes until deep golden on top and crisp underneath. Remove from tray immediately. Optional: brush with a little more olive oil while hot. Cool 10–15 minutes before slicing.

Cold ferment option (24–72h): After mixing, rest 2 hours at room temp, then refrigerate covered 24–72 hours. Remove from fridge ~90 minutes before tray transfer, then continue from the Tray step. (Ferment by cues: bubbly, airy, jiggly.)
notes: Designed for repeatability: weigh ingredients, use cool water, ferment by visual cues not the clock, never knead or punch down, and oil the tray generously for the crisp base. Total_minutes is set to 960 (16h) as a typical overnight baseline; adjust by fermentation cues. Yield: 1 tray focaccia.
